snippet.title: Super Mario 64 Rogue Chaos Edition 2.0 Update Trailer (F3 2026)
snippet.description:
Rogue Chaos Edition is back and bigger than ever!

Version 2.0 introduces new ways to play the game and brings the total patch count to over 200!

Get it here: https://romhacking.com/hack/super-mario-64--rogue-chaos-edition

Mod by: ArcticJaguar725, someone2639, Anoliah
Trailer by: Anoliah
